title: Vispix
summary: A shared photo library for teams to search, review, and select marketing images.
label: Independent software
paragraphs: Vispix is a collaborative photo workspace for marketing teams. It brings event albums, photo review, and shortlists into one place so teams can choose images together.

The product combines search based on image descriptions with team ratings, duplicate detection, and usage-rights information. It also connects the photo library to AI tools through MCP, making images available within broader creative workflows.
